_internalReasoning: Extracted all beverage menu items, categorized by sugar and dairy load into ranked tiers, and calculated average nutrients.
summary: Beverages on the menu range from plain tea and fresh coconut water to heavily sweetened dessert drinks and shakes packed with condensed milk and syrups. Opt for unsweetened or lightly prepared choices to minimize metabolic strain.

groups.groupName: Tier 1 - Safest Choice: Plain Teas & Fresh Coconut Water
groups.comparisonSentence: Unlike the heavy dessert beverages, these simple options deliver minimal added sugars and offer clean hydration.
groups.message: These beverages are the best choices on the menu because they avoid dense syrups and condensed milk, minimizing sharp blood glucose spikes. Ideal for maintaining metabolic stability while providing basic hydration or natural electrolytes from coconut water.
groups.orderingTip: Request less sugar or unsweetened preparation when possible.

groups.groupName: Tier 2 - Moderate Choice: Fresh Fruit Juices & Purees
groups.comparisonSentence: Compared to the extreme dessert drinks, pure fruit juices contain natural vitamins and fiber despite their higher fructose content.
groups.message: Fresh fruit juices provide valuable micronutrients, antioxidants, and vitamin C. However, juicing breaks down dietary fiber, leading to faster fructose absorption into the bloodstream. Consume in moderation if monitoring blood glucose or insulin resistance.
groups.orderingTip: Ask for no added simple syrup or sugar in your fruit juice.

groups.groupName: Tier 3 - Caution Choice: Mocktails, Jelly Drinks & Sweetened Teas
groups.comparisonSentence: These flavored mocktails and jelly drinks carry significantly more refined sugars and syrups than plain teas or fresh coconut water.
groups.message: These drinks rely heavily on flavored syrups, gelatin jellies, and sweeteners, which contribute empty calories and promote rapid glycemic responses. Frequent consumption increases long-term cardiometabolic risk and visceral fat accumulation.
groups.orderingTip: Request half syrup or fewer jelly toppings to cut down sugar.

groups.groupName: Tier 4 - Alert Choice: Heavy Dessert Shakes & Condensed Milk Bowls
groups.comparisonSentence: Unlike simple fresh juices, these heavy dessert bowls pack massive amounts of condensed milk, rich syrups, and saturated fats.
groups.message: Representing a severe metabolic load, these traditional dessert concoctions combine dense fruit mixtures with heavy condensed milk and sugary syrups. They deliver high calories, saturated fats, and rapid sugar spikes, making them unsuitable for frequent or casual consumption.
groups.orderingTip: Share this dessert item with others or avoid adding extra condensed milk.
